historical_reviews.deepseek: Recent tails can omit relevant messages and an empty result after destructive clear is not proof of health.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds protected baseline, exact observation window, full context/severity classification, known-event policy and clear audit.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Installation cases generate the evidence; this row independently governs the completeness and interpretation of post-install logs.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Non-destructive timestamp/boot-ID boundaries are preferred; if clear remains required, it is a separately approved action after immutable baseline export.

original_test_intent: Verify the complete approved post-install OS log window contains no unexpected failure, error or warning messages.
original_method: Agent exports/hashes complete baseline logs, uses an exact boot/time window or an approved audited clear, collects full OS/BMC evidence and classifies entries against the known-event policy.
manual_activity: User defines the post-install window and known-event policy and separately approves any clear; agent preserves and classifies complete evidence for user verdict.
required_inputs: Approved host/OS/kernel identity and installation endpoint
Required journal/syslog/dmesg/BMC/SEL sources and retention policy
Protected immutable evidence storage and clear authorization if retained
safety_requirements: Export and hash complete pre-state before any destructive log action
Prefer a time/boot boundary to deletion
Verify time/boot identity and evidence storage capacity
Stop on wrong host, ambiguous window, permission/storage/corruption issue or critical OS/storage/boot/BMC finding
Do not suppress warnings, delete additional history or auto-remediate
agent_execution_scope: Collect full pre/post raw log sources and hashes
Normalize time/boot context and classify every relevant severity entry
Do not clear without approval, truncate to tails, decide known-event acceptance or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve window, known-event policy and any clear
Resolve missing/corrupt logs and unexpected findings
Review full classified evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: journalctl and dmesg are relevant, but tail-only output and unsafe access omit evidence context and the destructive source pre-clear requirement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Export complete raw journal/syslog/dmesg and BMC/SEL for exact boot/time boundaries with hashes; audit a clear only after separate approval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Post-install dmesg/syslog review, source clear intent, no-unexpected-event Criteria and source 10/10 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable pre-state plus a deterministic boot-ID/time slice and full-context classification; avoid clearing unless the project explicitly requires it.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves forensic evidence while retaining a clean post-install observation boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Expands from two partial sources/tails to complete governed OS and BMC event evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Log severity strings alone can include benign known events, so final acceptance remains engineer-owned.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must decide whether log clearing is mandatory and provide the allowlist; the agent cannot infer that all warnings fail or that an empty log passes.
expected_evidence: Approval, host/boot ID and exact observation window
Complete pre-state journal/syslog/dmesg/BMC/SEL exports and hashes
Complete post-window raw logs with command status
Kernel/driver/storage/boot health, evidence errors and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require post-install system-log health review; the review constrains the destructive pre-clear step without changing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Window, policy, storage and any clear approval are supplyable inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Prevents destructive or truncated evidence from masquerading as clean logs and makes the reviewed window reproducible and auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A tail can exclude the initiating fault while retaining only recovery messages, and clearing before preservation destroys the ability to prove when an error began. Immutable pre-state hashes plus boot/time-bounded complete context are required; classification can flag entries, but only the approved known-event policy can determine acceptance.
